messages:
Tara Lim: flagging — customer ClearPath Health (CP-334) reported a partial failure in their bulk activation job at 01:45 UTC. Renewal touchpoint in 30 days. Need a short external update, an exec-friendly 1-2 line note, and office hours.
Alex Novak: can we get the top errors?
Tara Lim: support snapshot: `ingest: upstream 502`, `shard cache warm exceeded`, and some `request throttled` logs. Attachments uploaded to ticket.
Jorge Mendez: preliminary diagnosis: cache warm contention + batching pressure on their shard. Similar pattern to other bulk import incidents. Eng recommends: (1) pause tenant batching, (2) warm shard cache with higher concurrency, (3) replay failed batches in small chunks. Steps 1+2 ~35-50m; replay ~2-3h depending on volume.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-CP-334-2026 severity=P2. Assigned to eng-runtime + cs-response.
Tara Lim: CSM Lena please draft a tight customer note (<=5 sentences) with ETA and two office hour choices. Add ask for priority seat IDs.
CSM - Lena: Draft -> "Hi ClearPath team — were aware some activations from your scheduled import failed this morning. Root cause: cache-warm contention interacting with high-volume batching. What were doing: pausing continuous batching (ETA ~40m), warming your shard and replaying failed items (ETA ~3h). We will dedupe writes and rate-limit replays to avoid duplicates. Office hours: Thu 09:00 PT or Thu 18:00 CET. Were applying a temporary account credit and will deliver an RCA within 72 hours. Reply with priority seat IDs. — Lena on behalf of Redwood Support"
Alex Novak: small edit: change "pausing continuous batching" -> "disabling continuous batching for your tenant" and add safety note inline: `replays will include validation checks before writes`.
CSM - Lena: updated and sending now.
CSM - Lena: Sent to customer (ticket #94444). Customer replied: "Thanks. Please prioritize seat IDs 3001/3002. Thu 09:00 PT works."
Tara Lim: action items: @Alex disable batching + start cache warm. @Jorge reserve replay CPU and monitor for duplicates. @Lena send office hours invite and prepare exec blurb. Finance to prep interim credit.
Jorge Mendez: CPU reserved. Replay scheduled to start after warm completes. Monitoring hooks in place.
OpsBot: Change applied: batching disabled for CP-334 by Alex Novak at 1795004600.
Alex Novak: cache warm underway; ETA ~30m. Will post progress update at +30m.
Tara Lim: exec blurb suggestion -> "ClearPath saw a partial activation interruption due to cache-warm contention during a large import. Mitigations are in place, replay is in progress, and were providing a temporary credit plus a 72-hour RCA." Use this for the customers buyer.
CSM - Lena: buyer updated and invite sent. Customer acknowledged preferred seat list.
Alex Novak: initial replay tranche boosted activations from ~58% -> ~86%. Continuing replay; will post another update at +90m.
Tara Lim: RCA timeline: draft in 72h, customer-friendly summary in 8h, credits applied within 24h. We'll run a feedback pulse 7 days after closure: https://redwood-inference.com/incident-feedback?tenant=CP-334
CSM - Lena: keeping this thread as the single source for customer-facing comms. React when seen. :white_check_mark:
Jorge Mendez: :white_check_mark:
Alex Novak: :thumbsup:
